thread:
Anya R: Hey team — bringing up q8_int4 variant of sx3b on the canary. Seeing ~4% regression on the golden QA set vs fp16. Need to prioritize labeling/triage for a small edge-case cohort.

Sanjay P: ugh. where's the diff? can you attach sample ids or a quick breakdown?

Anya R: Quick summary: golden macro-accuracy down 92.1% -> 88.0. Failures concentrated on long instruction-follow prompts and multiline code blocks. I dumped a sample CSV: s3://redwood-evals/qbringup/1768012345-fail-samples.csv (contains 1k rows, recommending top250 first).

Matt L: pinging @label-bot to allocate annotators. we'll want 3-way labels on the 250 highest-impact samples, plus an extra 50 for spot-checks.

label-bot: Assigned 3 annotators to task qbringup-1768012345; 300 items enqueued. ETA 48h. Assignees: @soph, @carlos, @maya.

Jin W: can we prioritize those with 'code' or 'list' intents? quick filter I ran: `content_type in ('code','list') and tokens > 512` — yields ~320 candidates, narrow to top250 by model delta.

Anya R: yes — that filter looks good. Matt, can the annotators get a short rubric addendum? the failures are subtle formatting-preservation and trailing-newline loss.

Matt L: I'll add rubric note: preserve code fences, minimal reformat, and mark whether output lost list structure. Also add a 'regression_severity' flag (high/med/low). Will post template in #eng-ml when ready.

Sanjay P: For tracking, create a small eval harness: `python eval/harness.py --gold s3://redwood-evals/golden/1768/gold.jsonl --pred s3://redwood-evals/preds/sx3b_q8/1768012345/preds.jsonl --out results/1768012345.json` — then we can break down by heuristics.

Anya R: done, harness and initial run uploaded to the issue: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-4521 (linked charts show chunk-by-chunk failure heatmap).

Matt L: also recommend a quick quant sensitivity run to see if it's an encoding/activation issue: `run_quant_bench --model sx3b --variants fp16 q8_int4 q4b --seed 42 --promptset long_instruct --topk 40` — should take a few hours on a single node.

Jin W: if q8_int4 keeps failing, try per-layer mixed precision (keep first 6 layers fp16) or reduce per-channel quantization granularity. I can spin a variant tomorrow.

label-bot: @Matt L assigned: Add rubric addendum and create label task template — due 2026-03-22.

Anya R: action items recap:
- Matt: rubric + task template (include examples + severity flags)
- Labelers: 3-way on top250 filtered set (extra 50 spot-checks)
- Sanjay: run harness and post breakdown by heuristic buckets
- Jin: run per-layer mixed-precision experiments and post results

Matt L: ack. will upload template and a short example gif for annotators later today. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploy canary of q8_int4 to eu-west-1 completed at 2026-03-21T10:12:05Z.

Anya R: Thanks — I'll schedule a short sync with product/support after label results come in to decide rollback vs fallback route.

Sanjay P: will post preliminary breakdown in ~24h, incl. tokenizer-length stratification and sample-level diffs.

Jin W: I'll queue the mixed-precision experiment now, will share config and seed.

Matt L: template posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/label-templates/qbringup-1768012345.md — includes examples and the 'regression_severity' rubric.

Anya R: Perfect, thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after labels land. :rocket:
